lines.zh: 漆黑身躯掠过，寒气逼人。
翅膀摩擦，发出细微声响。
lines.en: Wings rub, making a faint noise.
The grass withers where I step.
Slow, but I do not need to be fast.
I'll read the distance out to you.
Wherever you go, I call out the count.

lines.zh: 我会一路报出我们之间的距离。
lines.en: I'll announce the distance all the way.

lines.zh: 距离在缩短，你数得清吗？
lines.en: The distance is shrinking. Can you keep count?

lines.zh: 你回头之前，我已经走了。
lines.en: Before you turn, I have already gone.

lines.zh: 我离你多少格，我自己会报。
lines.en: I'll announce how many blocks away I am.

lines.zh: 它的目光在你身上停留，似乎在算计着什么。
lines.en: Its gaze lingers on you, calculating.

lines.zh: 它的触角轻轻触碰着空气，似乎在寻找着什么。
lines.en: Its antennae flutter in the air, searching.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的声音，似乎在向你示好。
lines.en: It emits a low hum, as if to greet you.

lines.zh: 它缓缓靠近，那双眼睛闪烁着寒光。
lines.en: It approaches slowly, its eyes glowing.

lines.zh: 它突然停下了脚步，仿佛察觉到了什么。
它的声音像是来自虚空的低语，令人毛骨悚然。
lines.en: Its voice is a chilling whisper from the void.

lines.zh: 它的身体在空中轻轻飘动，仿佛不受重力束缚。
lines.en: Its body hovers in mid-air, defying gravity.

lines.zh: 它的触角紧紧缠绕在你身上，仿佛要吞噬一切。
lines.en: Its antennae grip you tightly, intent on devouring.

lines.zh: 它眼中闪烁着贪婪的光芒，仿佛预见了你的死亡。
lines.en: Its eyes gleam with greed, anticipating your demise.

lines.zh: 它的触须突然收紧，似乎要抓住你。
lines.en: Its tentacles suddenly tighten, aiming to grab you.

lines.zh: 你和它撞在了一起，感受到它的力量。
lines.en: You collide with it, feeling its power.

lines.zh: 它的身体坚硬如石，撞击时感觉不到痛。
lines.en: Its body is hard as stone, barely hurting you.

lines.zh: 你被它弹开，几近失去平衡。
lines.en: You are pushed back, nearly losing your balance.

lines.zh: 它发出一阵低吼，似乎对你有所反应。
lines.en: It lets out a low growl, reacting to you.

lines.zh: 你感受到它的力量远远超乎你的想象。
lines.en: You feel its strength far exceeds your expectations.

lines.zh: 我和你的距离，正在报数。
lines.en: It's counting the blocks between us.

lines.zh: 你几乎无法躲避它的撞击。
你感觉到它的坚硬外壳。
它的撞击仿佛带来了风暴。
它撞过来时，你只能闪避。
lines.en: You can only dodge when it collides.

lines.zh: 它发出交配时特有的低鸣。
它靠近你，似乎想要与你交流。
lines.en: It approaches you, as if to communicate.

lines.zh: 它发出轻柔的声音，像是在寻求伴侣。
lines.en: It makes a gentle sound, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛中闪烁着欲望的光芒。
它开始发出求偶的信号。
它似乎对你产生了兴趣。
它靠近你，发出求偶的声音。
lines.en: It approaches you, making mating sounds.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛紧紧盯着你，似乎在等待。
lines.en: Its eyes fix on you, waiting.

lines.zh: 它发出的求偶信号很强烈。
它似乎在寻找合适的伴侣。
lines.en: It seems to be searching for a mate.
I'll call out the distance to you.

lines.zh: 这里头有我要的那点光。
lines.en: There's the glimmer I wanted inside.

lines.zh: 我数着格数，把它捡起来。
lines.en: Counting the blocks, I pick it up.
I drag it into the black mist.

lines.zh: 我一口吞下，连渣都没剩。
lines.en: I swallow it whole, not a crumb left.

lines.zh: 这东西我收进虚空里了。
lines.en: I tuck this into the void.

lines.zh: 这味道，是我记下的那种。
lines.en: This scent is the one I noted down.

lines.zh: 你的距离，我正报给世界听。
lines.en: Your distance — I'm announcing it aloud.

lines.zh: 我的声音从你背后传来。
lines.en: My voice comes from behind you.
The count hits zero; you're in front of me.
I come to claim your soul.

lines.zh: 我报出距离，你在四百格内。
lines.en: I call the distance: you're within four hundred.
Five hundred and twelve blocks is enough.

lines.zh: 你的名字写着我的清单上。
lines.en: Your name is written on my list.

lines.zh: 不管你跑到哪，我都在数。
lines.en: Wherever you run, I keep counting.
I can smell the light on you.
Catching you is only a matter of time.
Stand still. I am nearly there.

lines.zh: 它离你还有五百格，我数着。
lines.en: Five hundred blocks away — I'm counting.
I don't tire; the void doesn't either.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经罩住你的脚。
lines.en: My shadow already covers your feet.

lines.zh: 距离在缩，我的脚步没变。
lines.en: The distance shrinks; my pace never changes.

lines.zh: 你将为你的罪付出代价。
五百一十二格，逃不掉的。
lines.en: Five hundred twelve blocks — you can't run.

lines.zh: 你跑得快，数字掉得更快。
lines.en: Run faster and the number drops faster.

lines.zh: 我的黑雾会把你拆成小块。
lines.en: My black mist will take you apart.
It is counting again: fifty blocks.
Forty blocks. Did you hear that clearly?
The faster you run, the smaller the number.
It does not breathe, so it never tires.

lines.zh: 你回头看的时候，它没动。
lines.en: When you looked back, it had not moved.

lines.zh: 它走得很慢，却从不迷路。
lines.en: It walks slowly, yet never loses its way.

lines.zh: 你绕的每一圈它都算进去了。
lines.en: It counted every circle you ran.

lines.zh: 你的火把在它眼里是路标。
lines.en: Your torch is a signpost to its eyes.
It passes through trees the way it passes through fog.

lines.zh: 它到你身后了，别再跑了。
lines.en: It is behind you now. Stop running.

lines.zh: 距离报出来了，就在你脖颈后。
lines.en: The distance counter says I'm at your neck.
Touch the void and you vanish!

lines.zh: 我会报出你还剩多少格。
lines.en: I'll call out how many blocks remain.
A long thin hand reaches from behind!
It slams a palm onto your shoulder!
Black mist pours into your mouth and nose!
It presses you into the mud!
The void seeps in through your wound!
Its fingertips pass through your armor!

lines.zh: 它站在你窗外的黑暗里。
lines.en: It stands in the dark outside your window.
When you wake, it is already there.
There is one shadow too many. That is it.

lines.zh: 它从你身后的空气里走出来。
lines.en: It steps out of the air behind you.

lines.zh: 爆炸的气浪推了我一把。
那支箭穿进黑雾，扎到我了。
lines.en: The arrow pierces the mist and finds me.

lines.zh: 那道光烧掉我一层影子。
lines.en: That light burns off a layer of my shadow.

lines.zh: 还有五百格，我数给你听。
lines.en: Five hundred blocks left. I'll count aloud.
